sources.title: OpenStreetMap water-body polygons, Visakhapatnam (Overpass extract, osmtogeojson assembly, bbox 17.50,82.95,18.00,83.55)

provenance.note: Lake, tank, pond and reservoir polygons mapped by OpenStreetMap volunteers, in a box that covers GVMC plus about 5 km around it. OSM is a map, not a register: small or seasonal tanks may be missing and names are as mapped. Drains and wastewater polygons are left out. Areas are computed from the polygons, with islands subtracted.
